item.text: The central tree is now 102 lines and 7,154 characters—about one-third smaller. The branches add approval recovery, prompt lineage rules, checkpoint copying, graph validation, and publication guards. I also corrected the relaunch call order and moved revision-mismatch checks from capture to comparison construction.

{
  "explanation": "The central tree retains all seven major branches while shrinking from 151 to 102 lines (32.5%) and from 10,860 to 7,156 characters (34.1%). Eight peripheral trees expand review, prompts, capture, execution, materialization, assessment and publication. [M] denotes modular structure and public/internal boundaries; [C] calls; [O] ownership and lifetime; [D] data dependencies. Cross-diagram edges attach to the concepts being expanded. Positions account for actual tree dimensions and leave gaps.
